description: AI Fruit Story: a short, dramatic and funny soap opera of 3D cartoon fruit people (a human body, the head is a fruit) for TikTok, with talking scenes, captions and music. This returns the ready-made fruit people, roles, personalities, plots, options and prices, and (with a cast) the exact prompts MakeViral's own writer gets. With a `draft` it also checks your story and gives its exact price, without any charge. You can write the story yourself and send it to start_fruit_story as `draft`, or send only the cast and idea and MakeViral writes it.

fruit.description: A typed fruit, e.g. mango (without presetId)

presetId.description: A ready-made fruit person id (fruit_story_guide), or leave it out and type a fruit

draft.description: Your own story: the JSON the writer prompt of fruit_story_guide asks for (title, looks, numbers, scenes).

idea.description: One line, or a few 'Name: line' lines the story must use

sceneCount.description: Scenes of about 8 s each. Default 6.

name: fruit_story_guide
title: Plan a fruit story
